LanguageData.BOR_CrystallizationText: {PAWN_labelShort} has broken too often under the psychosis. {PAWN_possessive} body has begun turning to black crystal, one part at a time. Crystallized parts stop working and cannot be removed.\n\nOnce half of the body has crystallized, {PAWN_labelShort} can be placed in an Umbral Transformation Pod.

LanguageData.BOR_ExoChargeEmpty: {0}'s exoskeleton has run out of charge and is recovering.
LanguageData.BOR_ExoModeDesc:
Change the exoskeleton's form. Every form draws on one shared charge of 4 hours. It drains in any form and refills while there is no form, so switch back to no form to recharge. A form needs at least half an hour of charge to start. Switching takes a few seconds: the old form sheds, then the new one grows on, and the exoskeleton is in no form meanwhile. If the charge runs out the exoskeleton drops to no form and has to recover for 2 hours before it refills or can be used again.

Camo: unseen, but unable to handle anything.
Utility: no armor, works much faster.
Combat: very heavy armor, works much slower.
No form: no armor and no bonuses.
LanguageData.BOR_ExoBlocksApparel: the Umbral exoskeleton leaves no room for clothing
